1.) Proc Item identification for ITEM_ID:

   Join PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_FINISHED_GOODS_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_MAPPING_CORE_PIT on ITEM_ID

   If Join is found and PROC_ITEM_ID = NULL Then retain the ITEM_ID from source (PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_FINISHED_GOODS_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT)
   If Join is found and PROC_ITEM_ID != NULL Then use PROC_ITEM_ID (from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_MAPPING_CORE_PIT)

2.) Aggregating Quantity at PROC level:

   UNRESTRICTED_STOCK_QTY = Aggregate UNRESTRICTED_STOCK_QTY on PROC_ITEM_ID level, 

   INTRANSIT_STOCK_QTY = Aggregate INTRANSIT_STOCK_QTY on PROC_ITEM_ID level, 

   UNAVAILABLE_STOCK_QTY = Aggregate UNAVAILABLE_STOCK_QTY on PROC_ITEM_ID level 

  GROUP BY ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD for above aggregation of quantities

Note: We re-aggregate and update the above quantities at a PROC_ITEM_ID level as they were previously aggregated at UPI_ITEM_ID level

blocks.text:
1-Filter PROD Lots -
LOT_OWNER_CD = 'P'(PROD). 

2-Extract Planning Items -
Retrieve PLANNING_ITEM_ID as UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_ID, PLANNING_ITEM_DSC AS UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_DSC, and PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM AS UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM from the view V_BRD_PLANNING_ITEM_SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_ASSOCIATION_CORE_PIT by joining with WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_PIT using PRODUCT_NM = (SHOP_FLOOR_PRODUCT_ITEM_DSC) as the join key.
  2.1-For PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM in UPI_FAB or UPI_BUMP 
     Also join with the PLANNING_STAGE data to map the correct PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM ; -- as same SFP can be associated with both FAB and BUMP 
     if PLANNING_STAGE is 'FAB', the map to PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM = UPI_FAB; 
     if PLANNING_STAGE is 'BUMP', then map to PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM = UPI_BUMP.


3-Apply S-Package Logic -
Only for PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS_NM in UPI_FAB, UPI_BUMP, UPI_SORT and PLANNING_STAGE in ('FAB' or 'FAB_END' or BUMP' or 'BUMP_END') -- (S-PACKAGE)
-create a column PRIOR STAGE UPI ID and set as
     When PLANNING_STAGE is 'BUMP' or 'BUMP_END', utilize IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_TRAVERSAL_CORE_PIT to traverse the BOM  to find related Bump items and capture as PRIOR STAGE UPI ID 
     When PLANNING_STAGE is 'FAB' or 'FAB_END', similarly use the same BOM traversal view to locate the Fab items and capture as PRIOR STAGE UPI ID 
-create a column IS_TRANSFORMED and add S-Package: Current UPI ID ⇒ PRIOR STAGE UPI ID, ''NOT APPLICABLE FOR S PACKAGE''
-create a column FINAL_ITEM_ID AS COALESCE(PRIOR_STAGE_UPI_ID, UNIFIED_PLANNING_ITEM_ID)

 3.1 Update LOCATION  -  for s package
Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_MESFACILITY_MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_MAPPING_ROOT on PLANNING_OWNER_SITE =  MESFACILITY_CD and PLANNING STAGE = MESPLANNING_STAGE (Note- map all end planning  stage to the non end mesplanning stage like fab and fab end to fab)
 -create a column WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD_DERIVED and set as - When the PLANNING_STAGE is not end stages i.e., Fab or Bump, take MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD(MES LOCATION) else WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD    
 -create a column TO_LOCATION_ID_DERIVED and set as - When the PLANNING_STAGE is End stage i.e., Fab-End or Bump-End, take TO_LOCATION_ID and if it is null then WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD_DERIVED 
 -create a column FINAL_LOCATION_ID when end stages then TO_LOCATION_ID_DERIVED else WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD_DERIVED
 -update column IS_TRANSFORMED and append with comments as per the location used  ' : USED ORIGINAL TO_LOCATION_ID' , ': USED ORIGINAL WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD', ':'USED MES LOCATION'', ''MASTER DATA ISSUE, NEED TO IGNORE''



4.  Update/Map WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD,
                              TO_LOCATION_ID,
                              FINAL_LOCATION_ID
     (As only TO_LOCATION_ID and PLANT_CD being used in Inventory CORE) with thier respective PLANT_CD from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT
      by joining the above location codes on MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD


5- ADD a new column AS INVENTORY_TYPE_CD AND PROJECTION_TYPE 
If Planning_stage like end and WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD and TO_LOCATION_ID is not null then INVENTORY_TYPE_CD =  INTRANSIT and PROJECTION_TYPE  =   INTRANSIT
else BOH and WIP Projection
If planning stage = non end stage then BOH and WIP Projection

6 Update ItemId and location id
a. Update Final_Item_Id for non end planning stages and  INVENTORY_TYPE_CD =  BOH
 utilize PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_LOCATION_TRAVERSAL to traverse the BOM  to find previous stage and its associated Item_Id and update in Final_location_id 
b. Update Final Location_Id for end planning stage to to_location_id  We have to exclude the record if this Fab item is External which we can find out using Location Master.-- (Refer/use R2 code logic)
If the Planning_stage is Fab - No change is done (Shouldn't go to BY, if it occurs we have to remove this case - write a DQ)
BOM Traversal R3 Algorithm:

Join the dataset obtained in step 2 with PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_TRAVERSAL_CORE_PIT bomtrav
on UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_ID = bomtrav.NEXT_ITEM_ID and  UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_CLASS in (UPI_Fab, UPI_Bump,UPI_Sort)

CASE
    WHEN planning_stage IN (Fab, Fab-End) THEN bomtrav.previous_item_id
    WHEN planning_stage IN (Bump, Bump-End) THEN bomtrav.item_id
    ELSE upi_planning_item_id
END AS prior_stage_upi_id
7.ADD a new column - LOT7 With LOT_ID first Seven Characters. We are creating this column for the purpose of lot comparison with FSCO Outs.
 
8. Pass the Point_In_Time as Last Saturday Midnight time for example 2025-07-19 23:59:59.00000 and fetch the records from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ENHANCED_INVENTORY_ANALYSIS.WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_PIT  PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_ROOT

9. Logic for Inventory_Qty:
Update in new column Final_Inventory_Qty and Final_UOM as 'W'
a. If the Unit_of_measure_cd is 'W', no changes are required
b. If the Unit_of_measure_cd is either 'U' or 'D' and Secondary_unit_of_measure_cd is 'W' then replace the Inventory_qty value with Secondary_Qty value.
c If the Unit_of_measure_cd is either 'U' or 'D' and secondary_unit_of_measure_cd is not 'W' then use V_PRM_MANUFACTURING_PARAMETER_ITEM_LOCATION_WORK_WEEK_CORE_PIT view to convert the Unit or Die into Wafer. 
How to Convert the 'U' or 'D' into 'W':
Join the Unified_planning_Item_Id, Work_in_process_Inventory_site_cd from PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_ROOT with Item_Id, Location_Id from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_PRM_MANUFACTURING_PARAMETER_ITEM_LOCATION_WORK_WEEK_CORE_PIT where Parameter_Nm is 'DPW', FISCAL_WORK_WEEK_NBR = 'CURRENT_WEEK' ('We can get Current_Week by fetching FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR WHERE RELATIVE_DAYS_FROM_TODAY_NBR = '0' ) and  fetch the Parameter_Qty. If this Parameter_Qty is greater than zero then replace the Value of Inventory_qty in Common_Analysis view with the (Inventory_Qty(from Root) / Parameter_Qty (from Manufacturing_Paramter view).
update column  IS_TRANSFORMED and append with comments like NO CHANGES in QTY, USED SECONDARY WAFER QTY, DPW CONVERSION APPLIED

Drop lots if planning site and planning owner site is null and is_transformed = 'MASTER DATA ISSUE, NEED TO IGNORE'

Drop Lot if the Item is an Order Point and Planning Stage is "End" Stage ( sames as r2 logic)
get the list of Items from sku for location = VF and traverse it to previous stage and remove these items from Inventory.

Create column PLANT_CD  and fetch PLANT_CD by joining with V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT  on FINAL_LOCATION_ID = MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD
10. If PLANNING_STAGE and PLANNING_OWNER_SITE - both are null - then update both according to the following logic:
   Fetch the corresponding 'upi_planning_item_id' - for this data row
   Join with BOM Traversal view - PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_TRAVERSAL_CORE_PIT bomtrav
   such that inv stage.upi_planning_item_id = bomtrav.item_id
   Fetch the corresponding 'previous_item_id' from bomtrav
   Check all the locations corresponding to this 'previous_item_id' from - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT 
   Then check if any of these location is 'External' - INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_IND = 'E' in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CORE_PIT

   Then update the PLANNING_STAGE as 'previous_item_class_nm' from bomtrav - corresponding to this 'previous_item_id'.
   Update PLANNING_OWNER_SITE = 'External'.
   Update UPI_PLANNING_ITEM_ID = (corresponding)'Previous_item_id' - from bomtrav.

   If no location is 'External' - then leave both PLANNING_STAGE and PLANNING_OWNER_SITE as it is.

Note IN R3 We need to bring all classes data

NOTE: 1. If the Planning stage are End stages that is Fab-End, Bump-End, Sort-End, we can include all the records without doing any ITEM-LOCATION (SKU) check. We can include both 'M', 'C' ITEM-LOCATION TYPES. NO SORT-END SHOULD BE SENT TO BY.
2. If the Planning stages are not End stages that is Fab, Bump, Sort, we need to include the records whose ITEM-LOCATION type is 'C'.

To PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT, send the Work_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_SITE_CD, UNIFIED_PLANNING_ITEM_ID from WORK_IN_PROCESS_INVENTORY_PIT to ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID column and get the corresponding ITEM_LOCATION_TYPE_CD.

blocks.text:
1.) CIBR Data:
    a.) Fetch data from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_HYBRID_WIP_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT (CIBR Data) 

2.) FFS + XEUS (WIP_SW=0)

a. ) For View IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_SCH_BALANCE_START_CORE_PIT (FSCO/APPS/XEUS Data) filter where LOT_OWNER_CODE in 'P' OR 'PROD'
 -  identify if an item is TurnKey or not  -
   join WITH PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT ON ITEM_ID AND GET NSB_FLAG (NSB_FLAG = N IS TURNKEY & Y= NON TURNKEY) and ITEM_ORDER_POINT
  Create a column INVENTORY_TYPE_CD and set as 'SCHED_RCPTS'
b.) Drop lots as per below logic -- For FFS drop all stages and keep only order pt stage
    if NSB_FLAG = N AND ITEM_ORDER_POINT = N for SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = FFS THEN DROP THE RECORD, KEEP ONLY ITEM_ORDER_POINT= Y
3.) FSCO + FFS + XEUS (WIP_SW=1)

a.) For View  IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE_PIT (FSCO/APPS/XEUS Data)  where LOT_OWNER_CODE in 'P' OR 'PROD'
-  identify if an item is TurnKey or not  -
   join WITH PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_SP_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT ON ITEM_ID AND GET NSB_FLAG (NSB_FLAG = N IS TURNKEY & Y= NON TURNKEY)
  Create a column INVENTORY_TYPE_CD and set as 'SCHED_RCPTS'
b.) Drop lots as per below logic -- For FFS drop all stages and keep only order pt stage
    if NSB_FLAG = N AND ITEM_ORDER_POINT = N for SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = FFS THEN DROP THE RECORD, KEEP ONLY ITEM_ORDER_POINT= Y

4.) LOT Comparision between FSCO OUTs and CIBR:

    a.) We need to compare data between CIBR and FSCO OUTS (PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE) where SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'FSCO' AND PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection'
         i.) If a Lot matches, i.e. exists in both views then (same logic as that in R2 - PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_WIP_COMPARISON_TRANSFORM)
        ii.) If the PLANNING_STAGEs also match & If both the CIBR and FSCO OUTS PLANNING_STAGEs are either FAB, BUMP,SORT and so on i.e. Non-End planning stage, we will leave them as is in FSCO OUTS and drop CIBR data 

     b.) If the PLANNING_STAGEs doesn't match, please do the transformation based on the below cases:
     i.)  If the CIBR Planning Stage is Fab-End and FSCO OUTS Planning_stage is Fab then remove this lot from FSCO OUTS. keep CIBR Data
     ii.) If the CIBR Planning Stage is Bump-End and FSCO OUTS Planning_stage is Bump then remove this lot from FSCO OUTS.
           and so on............... for all stages
Lot only exists in WIP projection(FSCO OUTS) - No Action is Needed (Expect to only see when new lot created at Fab Stage - Most probably doesn't happen to see this case).
Lot only exists in Inventory(CIBR): No Action is needed

5. Union all 3 views ( step 2, 3, 4 , from step 3 exclude where Source_sytem_nm = 'FSCO' AND PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' as already covered in step 4 ) after lot comparision betwee FSCO Outs and CIBR, keep all the data from APPS and XEUS - Aggregate all 3 views at Item_id. location_id, Inventory_type_cd, schedule_date
Map FINAL_ITEM_ID WITH ITEM_ID , FINAL_INVENTORY_QTY with QTY,PLANT_CD with LOCATION_ID, START_DATE with START_TRANSACTION_PST_TS, DEST_LOCATION_ID WITH TO_LOCATION_ID from CIBR view to final view, all other sources have same naming conventions
6. We need to bring only the records where BATCH_IND ='W' from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_WORK_IN_PROCESS_CORE and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_SCH_START_CORE.
6.)  Purchase Order Data:

a.) Fetch data from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_TRN_PURCHASE_ORDER_DETAIL_CORE_PIT  and 
      i.) Aggregate at ITEM_ID , PLANT_CD  and get  GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY, OPEN_PO_QTY, and OPEN_PO_DATE,  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT
      ii) Append/Union this data in the final view based on below logic :
           Set 
            SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'S4-IF', 
            PROJECTION_TYPE = 'PO', 
            INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH', 
            ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID, 
            LOCATION_ID = PLANT_CD
            QTY, SCHEDULE_DATE = ( a. if  GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY =  0  then  OPEN_PO_QTY &  OPEN_PO_DATE
                                                        b.  if  open_po_qty = 0 then GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY &  GOODS_RECEIVED_DT
                                                        C. if   GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY <> 0 and OPEN_PO_QTY <> 0 then create two rows one with GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY, GOODS_RECEIVED_DT and the other with OPEN_PO_QTY, OPEN_PO_DATE


7.) DIE Consumption (EMIB):

a.) Fetch data from V_INV_DIE_CONSUMPTION_CORE_PIT where LOT_OWNER_CD = 'P' and 
     i) Aggregate at ITEM_ID and PLANT_CD 
     ii) Append/Union the data and 
         Set:
         INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS', 
         PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection' 

         Map:
         ITEM_ID, 
         PLANT_CD AS LOCATION_ID,
         SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM,
         PARAMETER_QTY


8.) Substrate Inventory @ Assembly Location:

  a.) Filter  V_INV_ITEM_STORAGE_LOCATION_LOT_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT for records 
        By joining with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CORE_PIT on ITEM_ID
        where ITEM_CLASS_NM in (SELECT column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.T_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'Inventory_Core' AND business_rule_nm = 'ItemClass_Substrate')

  b.) Fetch ITEM_ID, 
                  PLANT_CD AS LOCATION_ID ,  
                  LOT_UNRESTRICTED_QTY AS QTY, 
                  SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM, 
                  POSTING_PERIOD_FISCAL_YEAR_NBR, POSTING_PERIOD_NBR 
        From resultant dataset from step 8a

       Using POSTING_PERIOD_FISCAL_YEAR_NBR AS YEAR AND  POSTING_PERIOD_NBR AS WW AND FETCH AS OF SATURDAY DATE AS 'SCHEDULE_DATE'
       aggregate QTY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND 'SCHEDULE_DATE'
       SET PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Balance Starts' , 
              INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH'

   c.) Append the data in the final combined view

9.) Supplier Substrate data (BOH): If PARAMETER_NM = 'SupplierBOH'

SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MaPPS',
          PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Projected BOH',
          INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH',
          LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S'
   Fetch ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, 
             QUANTITY  AS QTY, 
             FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR 
   from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT 
   join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR 
   and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for current WW (FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR) AS SCHEDULE_DATE
   QTY = Aggregate QUANTITY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID AND FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR
   
   UNION the data in the final combined view.
10.) Supplier Substrate data (WIP): If PARAMETER_NM = 'SupplierWIP'

SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MaPPS',
          PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection',
          INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS',
          LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S'
          START_DATE = (SELECT  column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'InventoryCore' AND business_rule_nm = 'WIP_DefaultStart')
   Fetch ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID,
             QUANTITY  AS QTY, 
             FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR 
   from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT 
   join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR 
   and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for following WW (FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR + 1) AS SCHEDULE_DATE            
   QTY = aggregate QUANTITY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID AND FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR.

UNION the data in the final combined view
11.) Manufacturing Order:  Query ParameterType from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_TRN_MANUFACTURING_ORDER_CORE_PIT to:
Filter only PARAMETERTYPE = 'Mfgouts': (For our consumption)

SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MaPPS',
          PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection',
          INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS',
          LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S'
          START_DATE = (SELECT  column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'InventoryCore' AND business_rule_nm = 'WIP_DefaultStart')
   Fetch ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID,
             QUANTITY  AS QTY, 
             FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR 
   from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_TRN_MANUFACTURING_ORDER_CORE_PIT 
   join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR 
   and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for following WW (FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR + 1) AS SCHEDULE_DATE            
   QTY = aggregate QUANTITY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID AND FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR.

UNION the data in the final combined view
12.) Bailed Items:

Query data from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_DETAIL_CORE_PIT
    Create a dataset by:
        a. ) select rows/records where STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_DELETION_STATUS_CD = '' and STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_DELETION_STATUS_CD=''  and STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_SCHEDULE_LINE_ACTIVE_IND = 'Y'                   (This filters out deleted/inactive records)
        b.)  Filter out records where GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY <> STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_QUANTITY              (This filtering allows us to keep only Open STOs)                                                                                 
        c..)  Additionally, keep only bailed items by JOINING the above dataset with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_SUPPLY_PLANNING_XFRM.V_BRD_SP_ITEM_CORE_PIT IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CORE_PIT on MATERIAL_TYPE_CD = 'UNBW'


Fetch the following data from the data set prepared above:
  SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM,
  PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Projected BOH',
  INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH',
  ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID,
  LOCATION_ID = RECEIVING_PLANT_CD,                                                                                   
  SCHEDULE_DATE = REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DT                                                 
  QTY = aggregate  STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_QUANTITY from above view on ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND SCHEDULE_DATE
13.) Finished Goods

Fetch data from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_HYBRID_FINISHED_GOODS_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT and

Map SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM,
          ITEM_ID

SET PROJECTION TYPE = 'FG Inventory'
        INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH',
        QTY =  UNRESTRICTED_STOCK_QTY + INTRANSIT_STOCK_QTY,
        LOCATION_ID = PLANT_CD,
        SCHEDULE_DATE = Saturday of Current WW
14.) EMIB:

Query data from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_EMIB_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT
      SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MAPPS',
      PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection',
      INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS',
      ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID,
      QTY = aggregate MfgScheduleQty over ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND SCHEDULE_DATE,
      LOCATION_ID = LocationId,
      START_DATE =  (SELECT  column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.T_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PITV_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT  WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'Inventory_Core InventoryCore' AND business_rule_nm = 'WIP_DefaultStart')
      SCHEDULE_DATE = As of saturday date for FsclYearWorkWeek,
      UNIT_OF_MEASURE = UnitOfMeasureCd

14.) Map PV_ROUTE_CD, OPERATION_NBR for all enabled item classes from  IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PRODUCTION_VERSION_CORE_PIT 
        by joining with PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_INVENTORY_STAGE_COMBINED on ITEM_ID and LOCATION_ID = IPV_PLANT_CD
        where OWNER_CD = 'P'
15. Referential Integrity Check -On Location w.r.t valid item-location combination in item_location_core_pit :

a. For all location_id - Check if valid combination as per IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT - Take the item_id corresponding to the location_id from - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_INVENTORY_STAGE_COMBINED(or put it before last view in CORE?) - and join with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT and (if item_id present) check if location_id is same as plant_cd (take plant_cd corresponding to item_location_type_cd = 'M' if both M and C present for this item_id)

b. For all dest_location_id - Check if valid combination as per IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT - Take the item_id corresponding to the dest_location_id from - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_INVENTORY_STAGE_COMBINED - and join with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT, (if item_id present) check if location_id is same as plant_cd (take plant_cd corresponding to item_location_type_cd = 'C' if both M and C present for this item_id)

Supplier Substrate data (BOH): If PARAMETER_NM = 'SupplierBOH' SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MaPPS', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Projected BOH', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH', LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S' Fetch ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, QUANTITY  AS QTY, FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for current WW (FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR) AS SCHEDULE_DATE QTY = Aggregate QUANTITY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID AND FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR UNION the data in the final combined view.

10.) Supplier Substrate data (WIP): If PARAMETER_NM = 'SupplierWIP' SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MaPPS', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS', LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S' START_DATE = (SELECT  column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'InventoryCore' AND business_rule_nm = 'WIP_DefaultStart') Fetch ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, QUANTITY  AS QTY, FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_SUBSTRATE_SUPPLIER_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for following WW (FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR + 1) AS SCHEDULE_DATE QTY = aggregate QUANTITY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID AND FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR. UNION the data in the final combined view

11.) Manufacturing Order:  Query ParameterType from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_TRN_MANUFACTURING_ORDER_CORE_PIT to: Filter only PARAMETERTYPE = 'Mfgouts': (For our consumption) SET SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MaPPS', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS', LOCATION_ID = 'VF_S' START_DATE = (SELECT  column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'InventoryCore' AND business_rule_nm = 'WIP_DefaultStart') Fetch ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID, QUANTITY  AS QTY, FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_TRN_MANUFACTURING_ORDER_CORE_PIT join WITH CALENDAR VIEW ON FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR = FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR and Fetch as of SATURDAY DATE for following WW (FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR + 1) AS SCHEDULE_DATE QTY = aggregate QUANTITY FROM ABOVE VIEW ON ITEM_ID AND FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR. UNION the data in the final combined view
12.) Bailed Items: Query data from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_DETAIL_CORE_PIT Create a dataset by:

a. ) select rows/records where STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_HEADER_DELETION_STATUS_CD = '' and STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_DELETION_STATUS_CD=''  and STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_SCHEDULE_LINE_ACTIVE_IND = 'Y'                   (This filters out deleted/inactive records) b.)  Filter out records where GOODS_RECEIVED_QTY <> STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_QUANTITY              (This filtering allows us to keep only Open STOs) c..)  Additionally, keep only bailed items by JOINING the above dataset with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_SUPPLY_PLANNING_XFRM.V_BRD_SP_ITEM_CORE_PIT IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CORE_PIT on MATERIAL_TYPE_CD = 'UNBW' Fetch the following data from the data set prepared above: SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM, PROJECTION_TYPE = 'Projected BOH', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH', ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID = RECEIVING_PLANT_CD, SCHEDULE_DATE = REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DT QTY = aggregate  STOCK_TRANSFER_ORDER_LINE_QUANTITY from above view on ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND SCHEDULE_DATE

13.) Finished Goods Fetch data from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_HYBRID_FINISHED_GOODS_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT and Map SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM, ITEM_ID SET PROJECTION TYPE = 'FG Inventory' INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'BOH', QTY =  UNRESTRICTED_STOCK_QTY + INTRANSIT_STOCK_QTY, LOCATION_ID = PLANT_CD, SCHEDULE_DATE = Saturday of Current WW

14.) EMIB: Query data from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_INV_EMIB_INVENTORY_CORE_PIT SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM = 'MAPPS', PROJECTION_TYPE = 'WIP Projection', INVENTORY_TYPE_CD = 'SCHED_RCPTS', ITEM_ID = ITEM_ID, QTY = aggregate MfgScheduleQty over ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID AND SCHEDULE_DATE, LOCATION_ID = LocationId, START_DATE =  (SELECT  column_value_one_txt FROM IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.T_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PITV_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT  WHERE subject_area_nm = 'Inventory' AND entity_nm = 'Inventory_Core InventoryCore' AND business_rule_nm = 'WIP_DefaultStart') SCHEDULE_DATE = As of saturday date for FsclYearWorkWeek, UNIT_OF_MEASURE = UnitOfMeasureCd

14.) Map PV_ROUTE_CD, OPERATION_NBR for all enabled item classes from  IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PRODUCTION_VERSION_CORE_PIT by joining with PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_INVENTORY_STAGE_COMBINED on ITEM_ID and LOCATION_ID = IPV_PLANT_CD where OWNER_CD = 'P'
15. Referential Integrity Check -On Location w.r.t valid item-location combination in item_location_core_pit :

a. For all location_id - Check if valid combination as per IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT - Take the item_id corresponding to the location_id from - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_INVENTORY_STAGE_COMBINED(or put it before last view in CORE?) - and join with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT and (if item_id present) check if location_id is same as plant_cd (take plant_cd corresponding to item_location_type_cd = 'M' if both M and C present for this item_id)

b. For all dest_location_id - Check if valid combination as per IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT - Take the item_id corresponding to the dest_location_id from - IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_INVENTORY_STAGE_COMBINED - and join with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT, (if item_id present) check if location_id is same as plant_cd (take plant_cd corresponding to item_location_type_cd = 'C' if both M and C present for this item_id)
